body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News> The visitors just couldn’t pass YAMAHA booth at CES 2006. YAMAHA USA has arranged a special stage for live performance so that the visitors can actually feel and experience live variety overview of their whole product line.
Due to the growing demand of guitars in the market these days, YAMAHA highlighted its guitar section among other product lines.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
